provenance.exact_model_note: Exact model backend not verifiable from final document text alone.

profile.name: DB core + hybrid profile v1 (RAG, LLM, LoRA, Tensor)
included_boundaries: small local llama.cpp inference and context budgeting
authorized database-sample selection and AdaLoRA training artifacts
Multi-LoRA serving and required-adapter failure behavior
profile.threshold_policy: Numeric quality/performance gates require a representative baseline and accountable owner approval; no weights or aggregate percentage are defined.

coverage.TEST_MISSING: No test evidence found for the required behavior.
coverage.PARTIAL: Existing tests cover only part of the stated contract.
coverage.REGISTERED_UNVERIFIED: Test and registration were found; execution has not been verified for the pinned profile.
coverage.BLOCKED: Execution or interpretation needs a missing workload, environment, model, or approved threshold.

execution.PASS: All required cases executed and passed with valid retained evidence.
execution.FAIL: At least one required case executed and failed.
execution.SKIPPED: One or more required cases were skipped; this is not a pass.
execution.BLOCKED: A required prerequisite prevented a valid run.
execution.NOT_APPLICABLE: Reviewed and explicitly excluded from this profile with rationale.

test_dimensions.rule: Dimensions are orthogonal. Focused is a selection, not a verification level; benchmark registration is not an execution result.

result_requirements: discovered test targets and case identifiers
CTest discovery JSON and CTest JUnit
per-case GoogleTest XML or equivalent, including internal skips
environment and model/tokenizer artifact identity where applicable
raw benchmark workload, corpus, hardware, sample count, warm-up, and measurement method

criteria.requirement: Trusted authorization and tenant/collection predicates are enforced on every retrieval path, including relational, vector, graph expansion, cache, and shard boundaries; caller metadata filters never grant access.
test_obligations: Allow and deny exact collection/tenant cases across retrieval backends.
Prove graph authorization occurs before cross-collection vertex reads or expansion.
Exercise concurrent requests with different authorization contexts and fail-closed policy errors.
criteria.gap: Source-level tests exist, but the complete cache/shard/HTTP/AQL authorization matrix has not been mapped to and executed in a pinned profile.

criteria.requirement: Every retrieved vector candidate resolves to durable canonical source content with matching identity/provenance; missing, malformed, mismatched, or metadata-only evidence is rejected rather than fabricated.
test_obligations: Round-trip vector source reference to canonical source content.
Reject missing, malformed, incomplete, non-string, and provenance-mismatched source records.
Verify no-match and vector-only metadata paths cannot produce fabricated evidence.
criteria.gap: The provider-level contract is represented in source tests; persistence/restart and concurrent re-ingestion behavior still need profile-level evidence.

criteria.requirement: Document, revision, chunk, and embedding identities are stable and collision-resistant; update, retry, delete, and index-refresh operations preserve idempotency and freshness.
test_obligations: Ingest the same document repeatedly and verify deterministic identities and no duplicate logical chunks.
Ingest different documents with overlapping local chunk numbering and prove there are no source-key collisions.
Update and delete a document, then prove stale vectors and source records are no longer retrievable.
criteria.gap: Existing identity tests do not establish global chunk-key uniqueness, update/delete propagation, or idempotent retry semantics.

criteria.requirement: Multi-sink ingestion reports complete, partial, or failed outcomes truthfully and preserves a documented recovery/consistency contract when source, vector, or graph writes fail independently.
test_obligations: Inject source-store, vector-index, and graph-store failures before and during a batch.
Assert the reported status matches persisted state and no failure is returned as complete success.
Verify retry or repair behavior for orphaned source rows and partially written vectors.
criteria.gap: The referenced suites exist, but this catalog has not verified that they cover source/vector/graph partial-write state and recovery; sink writes are not assumed atomic.

criteria.requirement: Cancellation, retrieval deadlines, backend errors, and partial failures propagate as explicit outcomes; HTTP status mapping is consistent and blocking backend behavior is documented.
test_obligations: Verify expired deadlines and cancellation before retrieval and during a delayed backend call.
Verify backend failure cannot become an ordinary empty-success result.
Verify the HTTP RAG route maps deadline expiry to its documented status.
criteria.gap: Route-level status, direct-provider behavior, timeout configuration, and all backend error paths need a single mapped run; cooperative deadlines cannot interrupt a blocking call.

criteria.requirement: Evidence selection and final prompt assembly stay within the effective model context window while reserving output tokens and preserving source attribution.
test_obligations: Use the serving model's tokenizer to count the fully rendered system, query, evidence, and output reservation.
Exercise empty, oversized, duplicate, low-relevance, and boundary-sized evidence.
Verify deterministic selection and that overflow returns an explicit outcome rather than silently exceeding the window.
criteria.gap: Existing budget suites are source evidence; exact tokenizer parity on the final production prompt and representative small-model windows have not been verified.

criteria.requirement: Inference evidence identifies the model artifact actually loaded, tokenizer/template, quantization, and runtime; a configured or requested path is not a substitute for loaded identity.
test_obligations: Load a pinned local model and assert reported fingerprint matches the bytes and runtime actually used.
Reject or explicitly report mismatches between requested, loaded, and training-provenance model identity.
Repeat with missing, replaced, and corrupted model artifacts.

existing_test_sources.registration: tests/CMakeLists.txt integration target; model-path prerequisite applies

blocked_reasons: No focused test was identified that compares the fingerprint with the model actually loaded by the training/inference path.
A pinned local model artifact and runtime were not supplied or executed for this catalog.
criteria.gap: Add a contract-level loaded-model identity assertion before treating model-backed tests as evidence.

criteria.requirement: Database training samples come from an authorized, revision-stable selection; filters are applied before limits, bounds are enforced, and malformed or unauthorized records fail explicitly.
test_obligations: Verify collection/tenant authorization and selected IDs are applied before the sample limit.
Verify snapshot/revision provenance is stable across a run and changes are detectable.
Test empty selection, malformed rows, duplicate IDs, and exact maximum sample/batch bounds.
criteria.gap: Current sample-provider cases establish a bound and malformed-input behavior, not authorization, snapshot isolation, or filter-before-limit semantics.

criteria.requirement: AdaLoRA checkpoints round-trip weights, active ranks, importance/statistics, scaling, base-model identity, and format/version metadata; failed loads do not destroy valid active state.
test_obligations: Round-trip every persisted adapter field and compare values within an approved numerical tolerance.
Reject unsupported/corrupt/truncated checkpoints without partial state replacement.
Resume training and compare declared identity and active-rank state before and after restart.

existing_test_sources.registration: tests/CMakeLists.txt integration target; model-path prerequisite applies

criteria.gap: Existing rank and checkpoint-creation cases do not by themselves prove complete metadata round-trip or failure atomicity.

criteria.requirement: A selected required adapter is either successfully bound to the compatible loaded base model or inference fails explicitly; a bind/apply failure never silently generates with the unadapted base model.
test_obligations: Inject load, compatibility, and apply failures for single and batch generation.
Assert no generation occurs after required-adapter failure and no success-shaped response is returned.
Verify adapter switch/cache behavior cannot reuse a KV/prefix state across incompatible adapter identity.
criteria.gap: Manager-level adapter failures exist in tests; batch inference's required-adapter failure propagation and no-base-fallback contract are not established by those cases.

criteria.requirement: Tensor abstraction and AdaLoRA conversion preserve declared shape, dtype, rank, scale, ownership/lifetime, and numerical behavior through the actual serving handoff.
test_obligations: Round-trip representative adapters through tensor export/import and compare reconstruction error against an owner-approved tolerance.
Reject incompatible shape/dtype/rank and corrupted artifacts without accepting success metadata.
Verify the returned artifact is consumed by the real local inference backend, not only an injected callback or in-memory cache.
criteria.gap: Existing bridge tests include stub/injected seams and do not establish numerical round-trip, persistence across restart, or a real llama.cpp handoff.

criteria.requirement: RAG retrieval and answer quality are measured against representative, versioned corpora with reproducible labels and a real evaluation runner.
test_obligations: Run retrieval metrics on representative corpora and preserve per-query outputs and aggregate metrics.
Evaluate faithfulness/relevance with documented, versioned method and human-reviewed sample.
Separate retrieval ANN recall from relevance-labeled RAG recall.

existing_test_sources.registration: Contract only; not an executable evaluator
Validates fixture schema and references; does not execute retrieval or metrics
Optional result comparison; no full evaluation run is provided by this workflow

blocked_reasons: Checked-in corpora are synthetic smoke fixtures rather than the representative datasets described by the contract.
No complete retrieval-and-answer evaluation runner or result artifact was identified.
criteria.gap: Provide approved datasets, executable evaluator, raw results, and owner-approved targets before claiming metric evidence.

criteria.requirement: The hybrid profile preserves ordinary database availability and measures retrieval/inference/training under mixed load, including the declared base-only, RAG, adapter-only, RAG+adapter, and tensor-enabled ablations.
test_obligations: Run representative mixed workloads and record database p95/p99, retrieval latency, inference latency/throughput, CPU/RAM/VRAM, and errors.
Compare the five roadmap ablations on the same corpus, model, tokenizer, hardware, and token budget.
Exercise model/inference unavailable behavior while ordinary database operations continue.

existing_test_sources.registration: tests/llm benchmark/test registration must be verified for chosen build profile
Static benchmark inventory; not an executed workload

blocked_reasons: No profile-level mixed-load or five-way ablation run was identified.
Numerical thresholds and representative hardware have not been approved.
criteria.gap: Define workload and baseline, then approve thresholds; do not infer performance from target registration or synthetic tests.

criteria.requirement: The readiness report proves that every required criterion maps to discovered targets and executed cases, and distinguishes missing, empty, build-failed, assertion-failed, blocked, skipped, and not-applicable states.
test_obligations: Validate catalog schema and unique criterion/test identifiers.
Fail profile readiness when a required criterion has no test mapping or valid result artifact.
Detect zero discovered or executed cases and preserve per-case skip reasons.
Emit machine-readable JSON with source/build identity and artifact references.

existing_test_sources.registration: Runtime wrapper; strict evidence policy is opt-in
Static inventory; does not collect CTest or GoogleTest execution results

criteria.gap: No profile-specific catalog-to-CTest/GoogleTest result join and readiness JSON was identified; current static inventory and runtime wrapper do not provide this crosswalk.

aggregation.readiness_rule: Not ready while any proposed-required criterion lacks valid retained evidence or has unresolved required status; do not count registrations, skips, empty results, or N/A without approved rationale as passes.
